## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL: Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive; broad sector strength offset by neutral risk ratios. Confirmation: XLF (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +0.72% | 1M: +7.89%) ABOVE TREND show cyclical strength while XLK (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND and SPY (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +0.65%) CORRECTION keep risk signals balanced.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Credit showing mild weakness: HYG (1W: -0.48% | 1M: -0.27%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -0.98% | 1M: -2.31%) BELOW TREND — HYG/LQD ↓ falling (credit stress modestly rising). Fear mixed: VXX (1W: +0.41% | 1M: -4.47%) RECOVERY → flat, while stocks vs bonds SPY/TLT neutral (TLT 1W: -0.17% | 1M: -3.77% BELOW TREND).

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral overall: SPY (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +0.65%) CORRECTION vs TLT (1W: -0.17% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND indicates slightly tighter financial conditions but no decisive move. Dollar and yield metrics are broadly flat in the data → neutral.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Cyclicals/value leading: XLF (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +0.72% | 1M: +7.89%) ABOVE TREND; Tech lagging: XLK (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND and QQQ (1W: -2.00% | 1M: -4.78%) BELOW TREND. Style: Value over Growth.

5. US vs Global?  
US mixed: SPY (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +0.65%) CORRECTION; China outperforming on momentum: FXI (1W: +0.68% | 1M: +11.36%) ABOVE TREND while EEM (1W: +0.09% | 1M: -6.39%) RECOVERY shows regional disparity.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Mixed-to-cool: IBIT (1W: -0.33% | 1M: +9.70%) CORRECTION shows crypto flows but ARKK (1W: -3.23% | 1M: -5.24%) BELOW TREND and SOXX (1W: -1.51% | 1M: -17.43%) BELOW TREND signal reduced discrete speculative enthusiasm.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Industrial and metals strength: CPER (1W: +2.24% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND and PDBC (1W: +0.52% | 1M: +9.89%) ABOVE TREND; precious metals strong: GLD (1W: +1.91% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND, SLV (1W: +3.83% | 1M: +1.09%) ABOVE TREND.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy broadly strong but uneven: XLE (1W: +0.72% | 1M: +7.89%) ABOVE TREND while Brent BNO (1W: -1.22% | 1M: +16.33%) CORRECTION shows near-term pullback inside a longer uptrend; natural gas UNG (1W: -1.75% | 1M: -13.96%) BELOW TREND remains weak.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
Confirmed: Broad sector breadth (10/11) and cyclical ETFs XLF (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND, XLE (1W: +0.72% | 1M: +7.89%) ABOVE TREND. Divergence: Tech (XLK (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND, QQQ (1W: -2.00% | 1M: -4.78%) BELOW TREND) vs broad breadth = minor divergence, not a regime break.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor exposure to cyclical/value ETFs showing strength (XLF (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND, XLE (1W: +0.72% | 1M: +7.89%) ABOVE TREND) and commodities/precious metals (CPER, GLD ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to clear laggards in growth/tech (XLK, QQQ BELOW TREND) and monitor credit (HYG/LQD BELOW TREND).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Financials XLF (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND; Energy XLE (1W: +0.72% | 1M: +7.89%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Technology XLK (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND; Semis SOXX (1W: -1.51% | 1M: -17.43%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: Copper CPER (1W: +2.24% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND and diversified commodities PDBC (1W: +0.52% | 1M: +9.89%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -1.75% | 1M: -13.96%) BELOW TREND; solar TAN (1W: -2.14% | 1M: -10.90%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX ~20 (sentiment threshold), HYG/LQD ratio ~1.00 (credit health inflection), XLK/XLF relative at current levels (watch XLK (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND vs XLF (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND for a style pivot), CPER support/resume above near-term breakout (CPER (1W: +2.24% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL: Breadth 10/11 sectors positive while risk ratios remain largely neutral, producing offsetting signals. Financials and Energy showing strength (XLF (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND; XLE (1W: +0.72% | 1M: +7.89%) ABOVE TREND) while Tech is weak (XLK (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND; QQQ (1W: -2.00% | 1M: -4.78%) BELOW TREND). Key risk to monitor: Tech/QQQ downside and credit softness as HYG (1W: -0.48% | 1M: -0.27%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -0.98% | 1M: -2.31%) BELOW TREND.
